title: Input
summary: The single-line control: text, email, url, tel, search, password, number and the date and time types, with an optional clear button, password reveal, number stepper, money format, prefix and suffix, and a floating label.

props.name: type
props.description: The kind of value. Date and time types open the platform picker.

props.name: name
props.description: The form field name.

props.name: value
props.description: The current value; what the form submits. A form reset sets it back to its initial value without raising the commit event, as a native control does: pk-form raises pk-reset after it, so a host that mirrors the value reads it again there. A browser state restore also sets it silently.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Hint shown while empty (ignored by a floating label).

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name (aria-label). pk-field fills it from its own label when this is empty.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Shows label as visible text above the field (linked to it), for use without a pk-field. Ignored by a floating label.

props.name: description
props.description: Help and error text, exposed as aria-description; pk-field fills it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction; also set by a disabled fieldset.

props.name: readonly
props.description: The value can be read and selected but not edited.

props.name: required
props.description: The form cannot be submitted while the value is empty.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Shows the invalid state and sets aria-invalid; set by pk-field or pk-form (or by a Blazor EditContext).

props.name: warning
props.description: Shows the warning state (a value the user may want to check).

props.name: valid
props.description: Shows the valid state.

props.name: min
props.description: Minimum value (number and date types).

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum value (number and date types).

props.name: step
props.description: Step for number and date types; also the stepper increment.

props.name: minlength
props.description: Minimum text length.

props.name: maxlength
props.description: Maximum text length.

props.name: pattern
props.description: A regular expression the whole value must match.

props.name: autocomplete
props.description: The autofill token, for example current-password, new-password or one-time-code.

props.name: inputmode
props.description: The virtual keyboard to request (numeric, decimal, email, ...).

props.name: size
props.description: Control height.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Shows a clear button while there is a value.

props.name: reveal
props.description: Password only: a show and hide button.

props.name: copyable
props.description: Shows a copy-to-clipboard button next to the value; disabled while empty and gives brief "Copied" feedback. Fails silently (logged, not shown) on an insecure origin or a denied permission.

props.name: stepper
props.description: Number only: minus and plus buttons that respect min, max and step.

props.name: format
props.description: money formats the value as an amount (1,234.50) when the field is left and shows the plain number while editing; value stays the plain number.

props.name: decimals
props.description: Decimal places for the money format.

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO currency code whose symbol leads a money field.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for money formatting.

props.name: floating
props.description: Shows label inside the field until it has focus or a value, then floats it to the top edge.

props.name: autohide
props.description: Password reveal: seconds until the value is masked again; 0 keeps it revealed.

props.name: debounce
props.description: Search only: milliseconds to wait after typing before pk-search fires; 0 fires on every change.

slots.name: prefix
slots.description: A leading add-on: a currency sign, an icon, a unit.

slots.name: suffix
slots.description: A trailing add-on: a unit, a domain, a button.

events.name: input
events.description: The value changed (native, composed: bubbles out of the shadow root). Read event.target.value.

events.name: change
events.description: The user committed the value (re-dispatched from the inner control, composed).

events.name: pk-value-change
events.description: The user committed a new value (same moment as change; carries the value).

events.name: pk-search
events.description: Search type: the debounced search text, or immediately on Enter and clear.

parts.name: box
parts.description: The bordered field that holds the control and its add-ons.

parts.name: label
parts.description: The visible label shown by showLabel.

parts.name: search-icon
parts.description: The magnifier of a search field.

parts.name: currency
parts.description: The currency symbol of a money field.

methods.name: focus()
methods.description: Moves focus to the inner input.

a11y: A native input lives in the shadow root, named by label (aria-label) and described by description (aria-description); invalid sets aria-invalid, and the state is never colour alone (the ring is thicker). Buttons are labelled and reveal reports aria-pressed. The copy button disables itself while the value is empty and its aria-label switches to "Copied" for a couple of seconds after a successful copy; a clipboard failure (insecure origin, denied permission) is logged, never shown as a false success. Money and stepper fields keep the number in value while showing formatted text. Text is 16px and the control 44px tall on a phone.

examples.title: Text, states and sizes
examples.html:
<pk-input label="Product title" value="Widget 1"></pk-input>
<pk-input label="Read only" value="AC-1001" readonly></pk-input>
<pk-input label="Invalid" value="bad sku" invalid></pk-input>
<pk-input label="Small" size="sm"></pk-input>

examples.title: Add-ons, money and stepper
examples.html: https://.com

examples.title: Search, password and floating label
examples.html:
<pk-input type="search" label="Search products" placeholder="Search products" clearable debounce="250"></pk-input>
<pk-input type="password" label="Password" reveal autohide="15" autocomplete="current-password"></pk-input>
<pk-input label="Product title" floating></pk-input>
